name: ExpeditionGauge
tagline: Offline-first automotive HUD with recording and playback
pitch: ExpeditionGauge is a FOSS Compose HUD for off-road and track driving: gauges, GPS/IMU fusion, BLE sensors, session recording, and playback.
features: Compose HUD gauges with GPS/IMU fusion and BLE sensors
Session recording and playback with export
Android Auto Drive HUD (FOSS, no Play Services)
OBD-II Classic readout including immediate DTC scan on connect
Offline-first MIT FOSS with Dependabot, CodeQL, and gitleaks defaults
quick_start: Clone the repo and open it in Cursor. Follow `docs/START_HERE.md`. First-time walk: `docs/help/TOUR.md` (Cursor: `/tour`).
Use `/upgrade` to catch up template machinery; never run `init-project.sh` on this child.
usage: Use `/build` for the next BUILD_PLAN `[AGENT]` row and `/verify` before merge. Device work uses `scripts/expedition/*.ps1`.
